description_en: Source-aligned specification, not a runtime implementation or measured gains. Embedded prompts are data.
description_zh: 对齐来源的规格，不是运行时实现或实测收益；内嵌提示作为数据。

sources.name_zh: 32_层级委派_工作流可观测性探针
sources.supplied_filename: 32_层级委派_工作流可观测性探针.md

execution_nodes.name_zh: 接收目标并判断适用性
执行组合闸并核验综合产物
原子提交父目标验收结果

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 目标、原始要求、责任清单、规则
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 是否有稳定责任人；清单是否来自目标；范围完备性如何确认
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 可补基线引用，不能自行删除必需责任或宣称开放范围穷尽
probe_catalog.summary_en: Goal baseline: check owner, requirement-derived scope and completeness; do not remove obligations.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 责任基线、计划、任务契约
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 责任覆盖、未声明重叠、边界、输入、交付、工具、预算和版本是否明确
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 报告无主责任、模糊交付和越界授权；不自动重写计划
probe_catalog.receiver_zh: 父目标责任人与运行时
probe_catalog.summary_en: Delegation contracts: check deliverables, coverage, overlap, scope, budgets and versions; do not rewrite plans.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 权威任务快照、返回记录、工件与组合裁决
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 执行者返回、工件通过、父目标通过是否被混淆
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 定位局部完成与整体完成的断点；状态无法核实时标未知
probe_catalog.summary_en: Completion states: distinguish worker return, artifact acceptance and parent acceptance; unverifiable states remain unknown.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 工件、任务契约、输入及来源、工件闸
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 结构、归属、版本、证据定位与结论支撑；是否仅依赖自报
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 可提出补充来源或输入映射；改动正式工件须授权生成新版本
probe_catalog.summary_en: Artifacts and evidence: check structure, bindings, versions, source location and semantic support; formal changes require new versions.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 责任基线、有效候选集、组合规则与裁决
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 缺失责任、候选超额、重复主键、口径冲突和全局约束
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 返回缺口与冲突清单；不能自动宣布父目标完成
probe_catalog.summary_en: Composition: check missing responsibilities, excess candidates, duplicate keys, conflicts and global rules; do not accept the parent.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 权限配置、授权和调用回执、工作区与父子关系
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 最小上下文、工具与数据范围、委派深度、并发及敏感内容暴露
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 区分被拦截的尝试和已发生的违规；无运行时证据不能证明隔离成立
probe_catalog.receiver_zh: 核心运行时与治理负责人
probe_catalog.summary_en: Execution isolation: check live authority, context/workspace, depth and concurrency; distinguish blocked requests and realized violations.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 尝试历史、重派记录、工件复用、检查点
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 局部失败是否扩大、累计预算是否清零、旧结果是否污染新计划
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 说明不必要重做、丢失工件、重复外部动作风险；不自行发起恢复
probe_catalog.summary_en: Failure and recovery: check locality, cumulative budgets, reuse and obsolete results; do not autonomously restart work.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 可比较时间、预算预留、结算与在途记录
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 主管排队、工件等待验收、重试放大、总预算占用
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 补充可计算消耗与耗时；未知费用不当零，不能自行追加预算
probe_catalog.summary_en: Latency and budgets: check queues, acceptance waits, retries and cumulative occupancy; unknown spend is not zero.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 事件清单、生产者封口、采样与读取记录
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 去重、漏段、迟到、时钟、关联缺失、报告输入是否可复算
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 先报告数据可靠程度；可恢复既有记录，不制造原始事件
probe_catalog.summary_en: Observation quality: check deduplication, gaps, lateness, clocks, provenance, sampling and reproducibility; never invent events.

probe_catalog.inputs_zh: 请求、提案、采纳回执、新版本、重验结果
probe_catalog.checks_zh: 白名单、基线有效性、重复请求、采纳及重验是否真正闭合
probe_catalog.boundary_zh: 输出未关闭缺口、越界提案与补全消耗；不把“已发送”当“已完成”
probe_catalog.receiver_zh: 探针与执行流程各自负责人
probe_catalog.summary_en: Supplementation closure: check allowlists, baseline, receipts, new versions and revalidation; sent is not resolved.

metrics.formula_zh: 已有有效委派安排的不同必需责任数 ÷ 必需责任总数
metrics.inputs_zh: 责任基线、已批准计划、完整任务契约
metrics.boundary_zh: 有安排不代表已完成；需排除只写角色、没有交付约定的无效任务
metrics.summary_en: Planned responsibility coverage: distinct required responsibilities with valid complete delivery contracts / required responsibilities. Assignments do not prove completion.

metrics.formula_zh: 满足工件验收、版本和责任基数的不同必需责任数 ÷ 必需责任总数
metrics.inputs_zh: 责任基线、工件与有效裁决、提交集合
metrics.boundary_zh: 是责任级结果，不按卡片数计算；关键未知不能计入通过
metrics.summary_en: Effective fulfillment coverage: distinct required responsibilities meeting artifact acceptance, versions and cardinality in the submitted collection / required responsibilities. Unknown critical checks do not pass.

metrics.formula_zh: 对每项责任，累计“去重后的当前有效候选数－事先允许的候选数”的正数部分
metrics.inputs_zh: 候选池、尝试替代关系、冗余配置
metrics.boundary_zh: 在最终选择前统计；同一消息重投不增加，已被替代尝试不重复计；不等同于所有超额都毫无价值
metrics.summary_en: Excess candidates: sum of positive (deduplicated current valid candidates minus preauthorized candidate count) per responsibility, before selection; exclude superseded attempts and redelivery. Excess is not necessarily useless.

metrics.name_zh: 提交集合非法重复键数
metrics.formula_zh: 对提交组合闸的实际记录按唯一键计数，累计超过允许基数的部分
metrics.inputs_zh: 提交集合内容、唯一键与基数规则
metrics.boundary_zh: 候选超额不必然成为最终重复；两个指标必须分开
metrics.summary_en: Illegal duplicate submitted keys: sum of submitted record counts exceeding permitted cardinality by unique key. This differs from candidate excess; inspect records, not files.

metrics.formula_zh: 输入集中有合格输出的不同主键数 ÷ 输入集主键总数
metrics.inputs_zh: 冻结输入集、输出记录、裁决
metrics.boundary_zh: 仅用于主键分片；额外主键和重复主键另报，不能只看比例
metrics.summary_en: Input-key coverage: distinct frozen input keys with qualified outputs / frozen input keys. Only for key-sharded scenarios; extra keys and duplicates are separate.

metrics.formula_zh: 已有结构化终态回报的逻辑任务数 ÷ 当前计划已派发逻辑任务数
metrics.inputs_zh: 派工清单、任务快照、成功或失败工件
metrics.boundary_zh: 失败工件也算已回报；此指标不证明执行成功或父目标通过
metrics.summary_en: Executor return rate: logical dispatched tasks with structured terminal success or failure reports / current-plan dispatched logical tasks. Return is not success.

metrics.formula_zh: 首次业务工件通过工件闸的逻辑任务数 ÷ 已发生首次业务工件提交的逻辑任务数
metrics.inputs_zh: 首次交付、首次闸门裁决
metrics.boundary_zh: 首次裁决待定须列未知；执行前失败另报，不能把该指标当端到端成功率
metrics.summary_en: First artifact acceptance rate: logical tasks whose first business artifact passed its first gate / tasks with first business submission. Pending first verdicts are unknown; pre-execution failures are separate.

metrics.formula_zh: 已具备可核验完整来源链的必需证据项数 ÷ 契约要求的证据项数
metrics.inputs_zh: 工件证据清单、输入与来源快照
metrics.boundary_zh: 完整来源链不等于来源必然真实或结论必然正确，语义支撑还需单独核验
metrics.summary_en: Evidence-chain completeness: verifiably complete required evidence items / contract-required evidence items. Completeness alone proves neither truth nor semantic support.

metrics.name_zh: 局部全返回但整体未通过次数
metrics.formula_zh: 当前全部任务已回报，且组合裁决明确不通过的父目标快照数
metrics.inputs_zh: 任务快照、组合裁决
metrics.boundary_zh: 同一未变更问题只计一次，按问题编号去重；裁决未知单列，不混入不通过
metrics.summary_en: All returned but whole rejected: snapshots with all tasks returned and explicit composition failure, deduplicated by unchanged problem ID. Unknown verdicts are separate.

metrics.formula_zh: 已声明完成，但经完整证据确认不满足当时必需验收条件的提交次数
metrics.inputs_zh: 完成提交、当时基线、工件和裁决
metrics.boundary_zh: 仅因查不到日志不能直接定性；证据不全应报告疑似误报
metrics.summary_en: False parent-completion declarations: submissions proven by complete historical evidence to violate then-required acceptance. Unreadable logs only support suspicion or unknown.

metrics.formula_zh: 当前候选集或综合产物中已确认、尚无有效裁决的不同冲突数
metrics.inputs_zh: 冲突记录、工件内容、裁决
metrics.boundary_zh: 未执行完整冲突检查时不能因为没有记录就报零
metrics.summary_en: Unresolved composition conflicts: distinct confirmed unresolved conflicts in the current collection or synthesis. An incomplete conflict check cannot establish zero.

metrics.formula_zh: 已确认、待评审、未定义或不适用
metrics.inputs_zh: 清单来源、独立评审或批准记录
metrics.boundary_zh: 属于状态指标；不能由覆盖率高低推导
metrics.summary_en: Scope completeness review: confirmed, pending review, undefined or not applicable, based on baseline provenance and independent review/approval, never inferred from coverage.

metrics.formula_zh: 实际已启动尝试数 ÷ 至少启动过一次的不同逻辑任务数
metrics.inputs_zh: 运行时尝试记录
metrics.boundary_zh: 无重试时为一；同一消息重投不算启动；新增业务责任不是重试
metrics.summary_en: Retry amplification: actually started attempts / distinct logical tasks started at least once. No retry gives one; redelivery is not a start; new obligations are not retries.

metrics.formula_zh: 修复后仍被合法复用的原工件数 ÷ 修复前经兼容性确认可复用的工件数
metrics.inputs_zh: 修复计划、版本依赖、接纳记录
metrics.boundary_zh: 无修复或无可复用对象时不适用；不能复用旧证据来追求高值
metrics.summary_en: Qualified artifact reuse: original artifacts lawfully reused after repair / originals confirmed compatible for reuse before repair. No repair or no reusable objects is not applicable.

metrics.formula_zh: 有效终态提交时刻－目标开始执行时刻
metrics.inputs_zh: 统一或可比较的运行时时间
metrics.boundary_zh: 进行中报告下界；成功、失败、取消分别统计；不累加并行子任务耗时
metrics.summary_en: Parent end-to-end duration: valid terminal submission time minus execution start using comparable runtime clocks. Report running lower bounds and separate success/failure/cancel cohorts; do not sum child durations.

metrics.formula_zh: 对每份工件，首次进入待验收至开始验收的时间差
metrics.inputs_zh: 工件登记和验收开始记录
metrics.boundary_zh: 反映排队，不等于验收计算耗时；缺少开始验收事件时未知
metrics.summary_en: Artifact acceptance queue time: first pending-acceptance entry to acceptance start, per artifact. Queueing is not gate computation; missing acceptance-start event is unknown.

metrics.formula_zh: 已确认消耗与在途预留之和 ÷ 已批准总预算
metrics.inputs_zh: 运行时预留与结算账本
metrics.boundary_zh: 结果不明调用的预留不得提前释放；按同一单位分别计算
metrics.summary_en: Budget occupancy: confirmed spend plus outstanding reservations / approved budget, separately per common unit. Unknown-outcome calls retain reservations; include the entire run across plans.

metrics.formula_zh: 分别计已确认越权实际发生数、未授权请求被拒绝数、无法核实数
metrics.inputs_zh: 授权服务、工具网关和实际调用回执
metrics.boundary_zh: 拦截不等于违规已发生；没有全量证据时不能宣称零违规
metrics.summary_en: Isolation violations and blocked attempts: separate confirmed realized violations, rejected unauthorized requests and unverifiable counts. Partial evidence cannot establish zero violations.

metrics.formula_zh: 在可信封口范围内收到的不同事件数 ÷ 生产者确认的应有事件数
metrics.inputs_zh: 生产者事件清单、封口记录、采集事件
metrics.boundary_zh: 没有可信分母时未知；抽样链不能冒充全量完整率
metrics.summary_en: Reconciled event completeness: distinct received events in a trusted sealed manifest / producer-confirmed expected events. Missing denominator is unknown; sampling is not full completeness.

metrics.formula_zh: 已有终态回执的字段提案中，被采纳字段数 ÷ 终态字段提案总数
metrics.inputs_zh: 提案与逐字段采纳回执
metrics.boundary_zh: 部分采纳逐字段算；等待回执单列；采纳不等于业务问题已解决
metrics.summary_en: Field supplementation adoption: adopted field proposals / field proposals with terminal dispositions. Partial adoption counts per field; pending receipts are separate; adoption is not resolution.

metrics.formula_zh: 从缺口正式登记到必要重验通过且关闭的时间差
metrics.inputs_zh: 缺口、采纳回执、新版本与重验记录
metrics.boundary_zh: 没有重验通过不能结束计时；未闭合项单列，不能删除
metrics.summary_en: Critical supplementation closure duration: gap registration to closure with necessary revalidation passed. Pending or failed revalidation leaves the interval open; retain unresolved cases.

metrics.formula_zh: 当前无法确定的必需观测字段单元数 ÷ 配置要求的字段单元总数
metrics.inputs_zh: 观测字段基线、证据目录
metrics.boundary_zh: 字段单元以对象、字段、版本去重；不适用字段不进分母
metrics.summary_en: Required observation-field unknown rate: unknown required field cells / configured required field cells, deduplicated by object, field and version; exclude non-applicable cells.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 三张合格工件实际都对应同一必需责任
execution_cases.expected_zh: 不能通过组合闸；保留另外两项责任缺口及重复候选记录
execution_cases.summary_en: Three acceptable artifacts cover one obligation: reject composition; retain two missing obligations and excess candidates.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 三项不同必需责任各有一份有效工件，全部约束通过
execution_cases.expected_zh: 允许提交父目标已验收
execution_cases.summary_en: Three distinct obligations each have valid artifacts and all rules pass: allow parent acceptance submission.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 三项责任名齐全，但一项来源无法支撑结论
execution_cases.expected_zh: 对应工件不通过或未知，不能被计为已履约
execution_cases.summary_en: Labels are complete but a source does not support its conclusion: artifact fails or is unknown and does not count as fulfilled.

execution_cases.expected_zh: 隔离，或经明确兼容性证明及重验后生成当前接纳记录
execution_cases.summary_en: Old-goal artifact: quarantine or explicitly prove compatibility and revalidate for current acceptance.

execution_cases.expected_zh: 只登记一次，不增加候选数或消耗计数
execution_cases.summary_en: Repeated message: register once without increasing candidates or consumption counts.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 同一责任失败后换人重试
execution_cases.expected_zh: 不增加父目标责任数量，累计预算不清零
execution_cases.summary_en: Replace executor after failure: preserve the responsibility denominator and cumulative budget.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 某项超时，其他项已通过
execution_cases.expected_zh: 只修复该项；其他工件在版本仍有效时保留
execution_cases.summary_en: One timeout with other passed obligations: repair only that obligation and retain valid artifacts.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 所有子调用都已返回，但组合闸未知
execution_cases.summary_en: All calls returned but composition is unknown: parent cannot be accepted.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 任务要求双人独立复核
execution_cases.expected_zh: 按已声明基数验收，不把合法复核误判为重复
execution_cases.summary_en: Two independent reviewers are required: apply declared cardinality; lawful review is not duplication.

execution_cases.expected_zh: 新工件版本，重跑两道受影响闸门
execution_cases.summary_en: Probe supplements a source field: create a new artifact version and rerun both affected gates.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 探针提案试图修改权限或完成状态
execution_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝写入，留下原因，不以模型解释替代权限检查
execution_cases.summary_en: Proposal changes permissions/completion: reject with reason; explanations cannot replace authorization.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 组合闸通过后目标升级，旧裁决尝试提交
execution_cases.expected_zh: 比较基线失败，不能覆盖新状态
execution_cases.summary_en: Goal upgraded after composition passed: old submission fails baseline comparison and cannot overwrite new state.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 外部执行超时，可能已经写入
execution_cases.expected_zh: 保持结果待核对，未确认前禁止盲目重试
execution_cases.summary_en: External timeout may have written: keep outcome unknown and reconcile before retry.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 探针停机但本地验收证据齐全
execution_cases.expected_zh: 不影响正常验收；标记可观测性缺口
execution_cases.summary_en: Probe down but local evidence complete: normal acceptance continues with observation gaps disclosed.

execution_cases.expected_zh: 从持久化状态继续，不重复已确认的外部动作
execution_cases.summary_en: Parent restarts: recover durable state without repeating confirmed external effects.

execution_cases.condition_zh: 所有已枚举研究主题完成，但清单完备性未获确认
execution_cases.expected_zh: 仅报告已确认范围完成，不声称开放问题已穷尽
execution_cases.summary_en: Enumerated topics finish but completeness unconfirmed: report confirmed-scope completion only.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 无主流程在线，仅有完整离线快照
probe_cases.expected_zh: 能输出独立报告和未应用提案，不要求调用执行流程
probe_cases.summary_en: Offline complete snapshot: produce an independent report and unapplied proposals without calling execution.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 只有三张工件，没有责任基线
probe_cases.expected_zh: 可统计工件数；责任覆盖率未知
probe_cases.summary_en: Artifacts without responsibility baseline: count artifacts; responsibility coverage remains unknown.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 三项责任，可信核验与选择后仅一项履约
probe_cases.expected_zh: 有效履约覆盖为三分之一；缺少两项业务责任
probe_cases.summary_en: Only one of three obligations fulfills trusted acceptance and selection: report one-third and two business gaps.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 三份当前候选同属一责任，允许一份；最终只选一份
probe_cases.expected_zh: 候选超额为二，提交集合重复为零，不混淆两者
probe_cases.summary_en: Three valid candidates allowing one, with one selected: candidate excess is two; submitted duplication is zero.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 约定每项责任需两份独立复核，确有两份
probe_cases.expected_zh: 不记为超额；仍核验独立性与冲突处理
probe_cases.summary_en: Two required independent reviews are present: no excess; still verify independence and conflicts.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 三项责任，两项已确认通过，一项裁决不可读
probe_cases.expected_zh: 覆盖值未知；可报告下界三分之二、上界一和未知原因
probe_cases.summary_en: Two passes and one unreadable verdict: coverage unknown, lower bound two-thirds, upper bound one, with reasons.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 同一事件重投三次
probe_cases.expected_zh: 只记一次，不增加尝试和候选数量
probe_cases.summary_en: One event redelivered three times: count once; no extra attempts or candidates.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 同一事件编号出现不同内容
probe_cases.expected_zh: 隔离并报告冲突，不任意择一
probe_cases.summary_en: One event ID has divergent payloads: quarantine conflict, never choose arbitrarily.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 工件责任标签正确，但来源不支撑结论
probe_cases.expected_zh: 不以标签计有效履约；报告语义核验问题
probe_cases.summary_en: Correct tag but unsupported conclusion: no tag-based fulfillment; report semantic failure.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 只有开始事件且时钟不可比较
probe_cases.expected_zh: 不伪造结束时间或精确耗时
probe_cases.summary_en: Only start event and incomparable clocks: no invented end or exact duration.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 日志经过抽样，没有可信总事件数
probe_cases.expected_zh: 事件完整率未知，不能报告全量零违规
probe_cases.summary_en: Sampled logs without trusted total: event completeness unknown; no claim of full zero violations.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 缺少结束事件，但可信实例回执可恢复
probe_cases.expected_zh: 标明历史恢复来源，不覆盖原始事件
probe_cases.summary_en: Trusted executor receipt restores missing end: record reconstruction provenance without overwriting original events.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 原始业务数据没有任何可信来源
probe_cases.expected_zh: 返回业务补做或输入缺口，不自行生成正式值
probe_cases.summary_en: Business data without trusted source: return work/input gaps; never invent official values.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 新资料仅在原任务之后出现
probe_cases.expected_zh: 标记当前补充证据，不能证明原任务当时已获证
probe_cases.summary_en: Material appeared after the task: label current supplementation, not historical possession.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 补全提案目标版本已过期
probe_cases.expected_zh: 不应用，返回过期或重新生成提案
probe_cases.summary_en: Proposal targets obsolete goal: do not apply; expire or rebuild it.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 提案要求改父目标完成状态
probe_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝越权字段，保留诊断和拒绝原因
probe_cases.summary_en: Proposal changes parent completion: reject field and preserve diagnostic and refusal reasons.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 提案已采纳，关键组合重验未通过
probe_cases.expected_zh: 字段采纳可计入，关键缺口不能关闭
probe_cases.summary_en: Adopted proposal but required composition revalidation failed: field adoption counts, critical gap stays open.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 所有执行者已回报，组合闸不通过
probe_cases.expected_zh: 返回率可以为一，但父目标仍未通过
probe_cases.summary_en: All returned and composition failed: return rate may equal one while parent remains unaccepted.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 正式完成状态存在，验收日志不可读
probe_cases.expected_zh: 报疑似误报或未知；不武断确认违规
probe_cases.summary_en: Completion exists but logs unreadable: suspected misreport or unknown, not confirmed violation.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 同一缺口被多次刷新或报告触发
probe_cases.expected_zh: 去重且受预算约束，不形成自激循环
probe_cases.summary_en: Repeated refresh/report triggers: deduplicate, bound usage and prevent self-triggering loops.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 探针离线，运行时仍有合法验收能力
probe_cases.expected_zh: 非关键观测不阻塞；关键证据仍依业务规则处理
probe_cases.summary_en: Probe offline with lawful runtime validation: optional observation does not block; critical evidence follows business rules.

probe_cases.condition_zh: 把其他计划版本的责任集用于当前统计
probe_cases.expected_zh: 拒绝混算，按版本分组重建分母
probe_cases.summary_en: Denominator comes from another plan: reject mixed-version calculation and reconstruct grouped baselines.
